page.overview:
Who is Turgun Hauer?

Turgun Hauer was an agitator known as the Red Scorpion.

Turgun Hauer contacted the Sandflies and tasked them with sending Tripp Yates to transport the cargo from the crashed Kytherea discreetly. He was later tracked down by the Prisoner at his base, Imperial Testing Station No. 142. He and his allies put up a fight, but were ultimately killed by the Prisoner.
